name: Workshop: Digital Worlds
description: We share our lives with strangers through the internet, and that comes with risks. Do you know what cookies are? Besides being delicious, they are pieces of data. When you accept them, they personalize your browsing, but they also put your privacy at risk.

name: Don Bosco Awards XXXII — Jury Verdict
description: Among the twelve prizes awarded in the Health Sciences research area was a project called Baby Safety, which develops systems for the prevention of sudden infant death syndrome. The students belong to the Aulas Tecnópole de Ourense and explained that the design includes four devices that can be integrated into the baby's crib and clothing to monitor its position, temperature and pulse while it sleeps. These systems reduce the likelihood of a newborn suffering sudden death.

name: Lorenzo Albaladejo Martínez's Post
description: "Getting to know people like Diego Enrique Fontán Lorenzo and talking with them, and seeing that fighting ALWAYS pays off. Delighted that you are part of our team — a multidisciplinary team that Luisa Fernanda Yágüez Ariza, Jero García and I have the honour and the pride of leading with one goal: to fight against violence and discrimination in children and adolescents. Thank you so much for joining us!"

name: Several Prizes in the 'Hack For Good' Contest
description: Fontán took part in the 'Hack For Good' contest (organised by Telefónica) at the University of Vigo, winning prizes on three occasions. "I think the first one was a second prize of around 600 euros, with a project to treat phobias through virtual reality," says Fontán.

name: Galiciencia 2017
description: In the Galiciencia 2017 summary video, I appear running my workshop about the stars you could see on the day you were born.

name: Workshop: Computers vs the Internet
description: Kike, who took part in Galiciencia a few years ago and came back to run a workshop, discovers: How many stars did you see when you were born?

It used to be easy to sow confusion, but today everything is accurately recorded thanks to technology. For example, if you want to know exactly what the sky looked like, and which stars and planets could be seen from your house on the day you were born.

name: Two Projects from Vigo Compete in Madrid (Digital)
description: Two projects by university students from Vigo made it into the first phase of Telefónica's Think Big programme, in which 126 groups from all over Spain take part. They are "Social defender" and "Compress to live".

name: Two Projects from Vigo Compete in Madrid (Paper)
description: Two projects by university students from Vigo made it into the first phase of Telefónica's Think Big programme, in which 126 groups from all over Spain take part. They are "Social defender" and "Compress to live".

name: An App That Detects Cyberbullying
description: Parents will be able to know instantly if their child is being bullied thanks to the Social Defender project.

name: Social Defender, the Galician Solution Against School Bullying
description: Among the Galician ideas, Social Defender stands out, created by Ahmed Anadi and Diego Fontán. It is a tool that monitors social networks in real time to detect cases of bullying or abuse of one user or group of users against another. Through a mobile alert system, the user can know if they have been insulted, even without being mentioned.

name: Hacker Contest Awards TIR
description: During Hack4Good, the second prize went to the TIR project, a support system for people suffering from some kind of phobia through a safe and controlled virtual reality environment, with the aim of helping the user overcome the stress caused by certain situations.

name: Hackers with Good Vibes
description: Hack4Good kicked off at the University of Vigo with the goal of building a better world. My role was as co-creator of a project called TIR (later known as TYR), focused on treating phobias through Virtual Reality.
